newsitem.title: USA: Leggoons hires Rick Howe as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Leggoons hires Rick Howe as CEO.

text.p: Leggoons Inc said Thursday it hired Rick Howe as chief executive officer and chief operations officer.
Thomas Hughes, chairman of Home Point Sale Inc, will remain chairman and president of Leggoons.
Howe most recently was vice president and casino manager at the Four Queens Hotel in Las Vegas, Nevada. Company spokesmen were not immediately available for further details.
Leggoons is focused on development of Home and Office ATM card and SMART card wagering in the emerging Personal Encrypted Remote Financial Electronic Card Transactions industry.
Leggoons is seeking approval to change its name to Betting Inc, the company said.
